question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct option is **Criminals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Criminal:** a person who has committed a crime.
 
• As the boy was sent to jail, it is obvious that he will be put with criminals because he has committed a theft. 
 
• Therefore, the most suitable option is **criminals**.
